title: test_fleet_guards: test_accepted_values_are_digit_pure_form is tautological
description: Edge pass of 048n codereview (kimi-k3): scripts/test_fleet_guards_cycle_min.py:92-98 — the test asserts properties of the ACCEPTED_VALUES constant against itself and never exercises the script or the pattern; it cannot fail for any implementation change (would pass even if the guard rejected 1/10/1440), providing false coverage while claiming to be an oracle. Fix: delete it, or make it real (assert the guard's form filter accepts these values via a probe that stops before the loop).
